headline: Medicare open enrollment runs through Dec. 7
pages: Open enrollment is underway for Medicare, which covers roughly 70 million people, and runs through Dec. 7. The plan chosen takes effect Jan. 1. About half of beneficiaries are in traditional Medicare and half in private Medicare Advantage plans, which often have smaller networks and more prior authorization. Experts urge people to read the Annual Notice of Change from their insurer instead of tossing it. CMS projects the average standalone Part D premium will rise less than 1 dollar a month. A KFF analysis found that people who stay in their current drug plan will see a 50 percent average increase, from 34 to 51 dollars a month. Comparing plans can save money. Source: NPR.
